data.title: Card Testing Micro-Authorization Velocity Spike
data.description: Detects high velocity of sub-dollar ($0.01-$0.99) authorization attempts from the same merchant or source against multiple distinct card numbers, a pattern characteristic of automated card testing operations. Recorded Future's 2025 report identified over 1,350 tester merchant accounts, with 94% being newly registered merchants. Normal merchant sub-dollar authorization rates are under 0.5% of total authorizations. Card testing operations generate authorization streams where sub-dollar transactions dominate, decline rates exceed 70%, and unique card numbers per source per hour reach 50-500+. This rule targets Phase 4 of TP-0038, detecting the execution of automated card validation at scale through micro-authorization patterns that deviate from legitimate merchant transaction profiles.

detection.condition: selection and aggregation and filter_card_diversity and filter_decline_rate

enrichment_required.source: Payment analytics enrichment (decline rate calculation over window)

falsepositives: Subscription services performing periodic micro-authorizations for card-on-file validation
Payment processors conducting legitimate batch card verification for account updates
Charitable organizations processing high volumes of small donations during fundraising events
